Who gets paid?
 Fernando Cervantes Jr. USA TODAY Nov. 16, 2026, 5:40 p.m. ET Hear this story The next round of November Social Security payments goes out Wednesday, Nov. 18, for beneficiaries born between the 11th and 20th of any month.
 Social Security payments are generally distributed on Wednesdays according to recipients’ birth dates. This month’s payments come as beneficiaries prepare for a 3.6% cost-of-living adjustment in 2027 , up from 2.8% in 2026.
 The 3.6% increase will take effect with Social Security benefits paid in January 2027. Increased Supplemental Security Income payments will begin Dec. 31, 2026.
 Annual cost-of-living adjustments, or COLAs, are intended to help benefits keep pace with inflation. The 2027 increase is the largest since the 8.7% adjustment that took effect for 2023 benefits.
 Here’s what to know about November Social Security payments and the remaining SSI payment schedule for 2026.
 USA TODAY Shopping: Shop sales in tech, home, fashion, beauty & more curated by our editors. Who gets their Social Security payment this week?
 Beneficiaries born between the 11th and 20th of any month are scheduled to receive their November Social Security payment on Wednesday, Nov. 18, according to the Social Security Administration’s payment calendar .
 Those born between the 21st and 31st are scheduled to receive their November payment on the fourth Wednesday of the month.
 When are Social Security payments sent?
 For most beneficiaries, Social Security payments are issued on Wednesdays based on their date of birth:
 Born between the 1st and 10th: Second Wednesday of the month.
 Born between the 11th and 20th: Third Wednesday.
 Born between the 21st and 31st: Fourth Wednesday.
 People who began receiving Social Security benefits before May 1997 generally receive their payments on the third day of the month.
 People who receive both Social Security and Supplemental Security Income, or SSI, generally receive their Social Security payment on the third of the month and their SSI payment on the first.
 Full 2026 Social Security payment calendar
 SSI payment schedule for the rest of 2026
 SSI payments are generally issued on the first day of the month. When the first falls on a weekend or federal holiday, payments are issued on the preceding business day.
 Because Nov. 1 fell on a Sunday this year, November’s SSI payment was issued Friday, Oct. 30.
 Here are the remaining SSI payment dates for 2026 , according to the SSA calendar:
 Tuesday, Dec. 1, 2026: December 2026 payment.
 Thursday, Dec. 31, 2026: January 2027 payment.
